answer: Give every applicant one ridge post with a basalt slab bolted to it, engraved with a chart of a single nebula. Each clear night the keeper logs the sighting with a pencil sketch, and a neighbor signs the page weekly. A warden climbs the ridge twice a season to match slab, log, and sky, and a copied sketch or a missed night voids the license and burns the 150 token deposit for 180 days. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 slabs and 1,500,000 frozen tokens. A fake keeper is like a sailor who steers by a painted star. The first cloudy night leaves the boat circling the same black water.
